content.rendered: You can feel the energy in the building as we are preparing to wrap up this school year. We have had a great full week, but as a reminder next week is a short one with early dismissal at 11:00 on Wednesday.  There is new information in this weekly email to finish up the year and information you will want to read about for next fall.
